cases.description: An alias file with an entry that is not an alias, here a from that is not a store path, is alias-file-invalid, an operation error with no record, and the check reports nothing else, since without the aliases references would be reported dangling that are not (§13.6, Appendix D; the valid file of the aliases store is its near miss).
Reading references fails on the same file, with the same issue (§13.6).
